caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal box with a hinged lid and a small lock at the front. The box is primarily black in color and has a yellow border around the edge of the lid. The surface of the lid and the sides of the box are decorated with red and orange flowers with green leaves, painted in a loose, stylized manner. On the lid, the text "M. RAU" is visible, painted in white. The background of the image is plain and light-colored, providing contrast to the colorful and dark box. The artist’s signature, “FRANCES LICHTEN,” appears at the lower right of the image.
title: Pa. German Box
